about: Baselines for npm run ratchet (tools/ratchet.ts). No count may rise; when one falls, lower it here in the same PR (npm run ratchet -- --update). Set 2026-10-16 (P1-01b). sourceJavascriptFiles (the site's own JavaScript in src/) set 2026-10-17 (P1-05), when the site's inline code became files; raised to 87 on 2026-10-17 (P1-07, with Theo's agreement) for src/engine/rng.js and src/engine/clock.js, which P1-09 renames to .ts in place; raised to 88 on 2026-10-18 (P1-18d, with Theo's agreement) for src/ui/gm/turn-shell.js, the turn's shell split out of src/engine/run-turn.js, which P1-09 renames in place too. stubDbTests raised to 80 on 2026-10-18 (P1-18a, with Theo's agreement) for tests/page/turn-shell.test.ts, the one file the P1-18 series adds on the stand-in database (P1-18d's and P1-18e's page tests go in it too).
